identity.description: Shopify: commerce platform for online stores and point-of-sale. Developer docs at shopify.dev cover the Admin GraphQL API, app auth, webhooks, and the Dev MCP server.
identity.identity_notes: shopify.dev is Shopify's developer documentation site, and the pages fetched describe Shopify stores, the Admin API, and the Dev Dashboard. The product is clearly identified.

auth.oauth_flows: Authorization code grant (merchant redirected to Shopify to approve access), token exchange (ID token exchanged for access token, for apps running inside the Shopify admin), and client credentials grant (client secret, for stores in the app's organization). Access tokens are offline (default, persist across sessions) or online (tied to a staff member's session).
auth.token_refresh: unknown (token lifetimes and refresh procedure not stated in fetched docs)
auth.scopes_notes: Scopes are approved by the merchant. Approving new scopes requires the 'Manage and install apps and channels' permission and the 'Develop apps' permission, plus store permissions for each requested scope.

access.production_restrictions: Development stores are for development and testing only and cannot process real transactions. Per a search summary, dev stores can only install free and partner-friendly apps (not fetched verbatim). Public app distribution review was not checked.

resources: Admin GraphQL API (QueryRoot entry point, e.g. products query)
write_ops: mutations (existence stated; specific mutations not enumerated in fetched page)
api.rate_limits: Admin GraphQL is cost-based: 'rate-limited using calculated query costs, measured in cost points.'
api.limitations: The fetched Admin GraphQL page does not enumerate resources, so breadth is unestablished. Admin-created custom apps can no longer be created; new apps go through the Dev Dashboard or Shopify CLI. A REST Admin API status and SDK list were not confirmed.

open_questions: Shopify/dev-mcp GitHub repo ownership and license could not be verified (fetch returned 404). The official status rests on the shopify.dev docs.

Official Shopify Storefront MCP, Global Catalog MCP, and UCP MCP endpoints (e.g., /api/ucp/mcp) were mentioned only in third-party guides and were not verified on shopify.dev. Their official status and auth are unknown.
Admin GraphQL resource list and breadth (products, orders, customers, etc.) not confirmed from a primary page.
REST Admin API status (legacy or current) not confirmed.
Official SDK list (e.g., @shopify/shopify-api, Shopify CLI) not confirmed; the webhook page did not mention SDKs.
Access token lifetimes and refresh behavior not confirmed.
Whether a trial is offered, whether public app distribution requires app review, and whether admin or store-owner approval is needed to install in a customer store were not confirmed.
Partner account and free dev store claims rely on a search snippet from help.shopify.com that was not fetched verbatim.

assessment.approach: Wrap/benchmark vendor's official MCP server; add managed auth
rationale: Self-serve test credentials (free self serve) and a documented GraphQL interface.
